explain: Two element sets separated by a near-zero epoch gap produce a longitude difference divided by almost nothing, and the quotient diverges. The object has not moved unusually at all. Check the epoch separation of the inputs before believing any derived rate. Carrying a rough sense of what is physically possible is the filter that catches this in a glance.
calibration: middling confidence, matched to a middling read

score_components.explain: Confidence recorded and scored by proper scoring rule. Being uncertain when you should be is worth as much as being confident when you should be.
